title: Projects

title: Projects
section: Predicting Job Salaries with Machine Learning on Scale
text:
Predicting Job Salaries with Machine Learning on Scale
Tech stack: PySpark, MLlib, Random Forest, Generalized Linear Regression
Built and compared three regression models — Generalized Linear Regression, Polynomial Regression, and Random Forest — to predict job salaries from structured features (experience, education, location, remote-work type) at scale using PySpark. Diagnosed and resolved a near-singular design matrix issue caused by sparse one-hot-encoded categories, and selected Random Forest as the best-performing model (R² = 0.47) based on RMSE, AIC, and BIC comparisons.
View source code →

title: Projects
text:
Big Data Visualization at Scale
Tech stack: PySpark, Plotly, Python
Processed and visualized large-scale job posting data using PySpark for aggregation and Plotly for interactive charts, exploring salary trends, remote-work patterns, and regional differences across the U.S. labor market.
